test_linear_bandit_learn: test the LinearBandit policy learner by training on a TransitionBatch and verifying reward predictions
test_linear_ucb_scores: test the LinearBandit get_scores method with UCBExploration to compute UCB scores for action spaces
test_linear_ucb_act: test the LinearBandit act method to select the highest-scoring action from a DiscreteActionSpace
test_linear_thompson_sampling_act: test the LinearBandit act method with ThompsonSamplingExplorationLinear for stochastic action selection
test_linear_discounting: test the LinearBandit discounting mechanism by verifying weighted A and b matrices after repeated training
